headline: Oversubscribed government bonds – 3-month discount treasury bill rose with a yield increase
summary: Demand at Hungary's Tuesday government bond auction stayed strong, with investor interest in three-month discount treasury bills more than one and a half times the amount offered. The yield rose.
why: Government treasury bill auctions set short-term sovereign funding costs, which anchor local interest rate expectations for Hungarian investors.
